arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BOIDENT2-PROBE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-CAPITAL-PCT PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-PROFIT-PCT PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-CONTROL-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
01 WS-BO-THRESHOLD PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 10.00.
01 WS-IS-BO PIC X VALUE 'N'.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PCT
ACCEPT WS-PROFIT-PCT
ACCEPT WS-CONTROL-IND
IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT >= WS-BO-THRESHOLD
OR WS-PROFIT-PCT > WS-BO-THRESHOLD
OR WS-CONTROL-IND = 'Y'
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
END-IF
DISPLAY 'BO: ' WS-IS-BO
STOP RUN.
